shortDefinition: A repeatable sequence of AI-powered steps designed to consistently produce a desired output.
fullDefinition: An AI workflow is a defined, repeatable process that combines one or more AI prompts or agents with human input steps and output actions to reliably accomplish a task. Workflows turn one-off AI interactions into systematic processes. They can be informal (a sequence of saved prompts) or formal (built in a no-code tool like Zapier or Make).
